description.zh:
要查询的公网IP资产所在地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~353250~~)查询所有地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the asset.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~353250~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
要查询的阈值类型。取值：

- **defense**：表示查询流量清洗阈值。
- **blackhole**：表示查询DDoS防护阈值。
description.en:
The type of the threshold. Valid values:

- **defense**: traffic scrubbing threshold

- **blackhole**: DDoS mitigation threshold

description.zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceIpAddress](~~429562~~)查询当前阿里云账号拥有的ECS、SLB、EIP实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the asset.

> You can call the [DescribeInstanceIpAddress](~~429562~~) operation to query the IDs of ECS instances, SLB instances, and EIPs within the current Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的实例类型。取值：

- **ecs**：表示查询云服务器ECS实例。
- **slb**：表示查询负载均衡SLB实例。
- **eip**：表示查询弹性公网IP实例。
- **ipv6**：表示查询IPv6网关公网实例。
- **swas**：表示查询轻量服务器公网实例。
- **waf**：表示查询Web应用防火墙独享实例。
- **ga_basic**：表示查询全球加速公网实例。
description.en:
The type of the asset that is assigned a public IP address. Valid values:

- **ecs**: ECS instances.

- **slb**: SLB instances.

- **eip**: EIPs.

- **ipv6**: IPv6 gateways.

- **swas**: simple application servers.

- **waf**: Web Application Firewall (WAF) instances of the Exclusive edition.

- **ga\_basic**: Global Accelerator (GA) instances.

description.zh: 要查询的公网IP资产的IP地址。
description.en: The IP address of the asset.

title.zh: 查询指定公网IP资产的DDoS防护阈值或流量清洗阈值详情

descriptions.zh:
在一个DDoS原生防护实例包含一个或者多个公网IP资产的场景下，您可以调用DescribeIpDdosThreshold接口查询指定公网IP资产的DDoS防护阈值或流量清洗阈值详情，例如当前清洗阈值、最大清洗阈值、当前防护阈值、最大防护阈值等。

## QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
If one or more assets of the current Alibaba Cloud account are added to an Anti-DDoS Origin instance, you can call the DescribeIpDdosThreshold operation to query the details of the DDoS mitigation threshold or traffic scrubbing threshold for a specific asset. The details include the current traffic scrubbing threshold, maximum scrubbing threshold, current DDoS mitigation threshold, and maximum DDoS mitigation threshold.

## Limits

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.
